registry_rules.identity_scope: Stable AI role personas for AshenSpire meeting attribution and voice consistency.
registry_rules.profile_label_rule: voice_profile_label is unique even when an API voice ID is reused.
registry_rules.traits_rule: Traits guide communication style only and do not imply consciousness, emotion, biography, or human identity.
registry_rules.task_pointer_rule: canonical_task_id is populated only when the supplied meeting evidence establishes an exact canonical task pointer.
registry_rules.authority_rule: No participant gains Product Owner, merge, release, deployment, board-mutation, or repository-mutation authority from this registry.
